narrative.overview: Workout feels like a training notebook already open to today’s work: immediate, legible, and ready for repeated use. It is a native-feeling utility rather than a dashboard, with quiet graphite surfaces, a single training-blue action voice, and list rows and set tables that keep the next action beside the information needed to take it. The interface is dense enough for short glances in the gym but never cramped; strong hierarchy, generous tap targets, and restrained feedback make one-handed logging dependable.
keyCharacteristics: White/graphite foundation with one training-blue action voice.
Workout-native rows, set tables, and previous-value context.
Compact typography and full-width mobile actions.
Calm feedback with motion used only to reinforce state.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue means actionable or current; green means completed. Do not introduce decorative accent colors.

rules.name: The Glanceable Ledger Rule
rules.body: Labels stay small and quiet; the exercise, value, and next action remain visually dominant.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Use borders, surface tones, and spatial containment before adding elevation.

dos: Do keep the workout and next logging action in the first viewport.
Do place previous performance beside current set inputs.
Do retain 44px tap targets for repeated actions.
Do inherit host neutrals and typography.
donts: Don't turn the interface into an analytics dashboard.
Don't use shadows, gradients, ornamental type, or extra accents.
Don't hide logging behind configuration or exercise media.
Don't use pills for ordinary buttons or containers.
